rocky.operator_kickstart:
# Synthetic operator Kickstart: replace it with your own. Build adds the blank-disk guard before
# this text and the completion marker after it (ADR 0034); the rest is yours.
text
lang en_US.UTF-8
keyboard us
timezone UTC --utc
rootpw --lock
user --name=exampleuser --lock
sshkey --username=exampleuser "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINdamAGCsQq31Uv+08lkBzoO4XLz2qYjJa8CGmj3B1Ea synthetic-test-key"
firstboot --disable
selinux --enforcing
zerombr
clearpart --all --initlabel
autopart
bootloader --location=mbr --leavebootorder --append="console=hvc0 ipv6.disable=1"

%packages --excludedocs
@^minimal-environment
%end

reboot
